turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My group of friends wants to do something on Saturday night and they've put me in charge, help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's an escape room in town that fits six people, about an hour, and then we could grab food after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone suggested karaoke, private booth, but half of us can't sing and one person hates it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a pub quiz at the local, cheap and easy, though it gets super crowded and loud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd go for the escape room. It's a shared challenge, nobody has to perform, and it fits your six exactly. Save karaoke for a night when everyone's keen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? We're at a holiday cottage and all there is is a deck of cards. Any games for four adults?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Loads. Hearts is a great one for four, easy to learn, and a bit mean in a fun way.
